companies.name: フォージ・グローバル

relations.text: 2025年11月、Schwabに買収される合併契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a merger agreement in November 2025 to be acquired by Schwab

source.label: Forge Global 10-Q(2025年11月)
source.quote: On November 5, 2025, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Schwab Merger Agreement")

companies.name: トロント・ドミニオン銀行

relations.text: Schwab株を保有していたが、2024年8月に4,050万株を売却(預金の取り決めIDAもある)
relations.text_en: Held Schwab shares, selling 40.5 million in August 2024; the two also have an insured deposit agreement

source.label: Toronto-Dominion Bank 年次報告(40-F)(2024年提出)
source.quote: On August 21, 2024, the Bank sold 40.5 million shares of common stock of The Charles Schwab Corporation ("Schwab")

companies.name: ダラス連邦住宅貸付銀行
companies.name_en: Federal Home Loan Bank of Dallas
companies.sub: 住宅金融の公的金融機関

relations.text: Schwabの銀行子会社が最大の借り手(貸付残高の24.2%)
relations.text_en: Schwab's bank is its largest borrower, 24.2% of advances

source.label: Federal Home Loan Bank of Dallas 10-K(2025年提出)
source.label_en: Federal Home Loan Bank of Dallas 10-K (filed 2025-03)
source.quote: Advances to the Bank's three largest borrowers (Charles Schwab Bank, SSB, USAA Federal Savings Bank and American General Life Insurance Company) represented 24.2 percent

relations.text: 販売を広げる提携先のプラットフォームの一社がCharles Schwab
relations.text_en: Charles Schwab is one of the platforms it partners with to reach clients

source.label: WisdomTree 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: deepen partnerships with platforms such as Merrill Lynch, LPL Financial, UBS, Charles Schwab

relations.text: SEIが10-Kで、カストディ業務の主な競合としてCharles Schwabを挙げる
relations.text_en: SEI names Charles Schwab among principal competitors focused on custody

source.label: Sei Investments 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: as well as diversified firms that focus on custody operations, such as Charles Schwab & Co., Inc., and Fidelity Investments.

relations.text: SS&Cが10-Kで、資産管理プラットフォームの競合(カストディアン)としてCharles Schwabを挙げる
relations.text_en: SS&C names Charles Schwab among custodians competing with its wealth platform

source.label: SS&C Technologies 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: custodians such as Charles Schwab, Fidelity and Raymond James.

relations.text: Webullが年次報告で、主な競合の伝統的な証券会社としてCharles Schwabを挙げる
relations.text_en: Webull names Charles Schwab among traditional brokerages it competes with

source.label: Webull 年次報告(20-F)(2026年提出)
source.quote: as well as more traditional and hybrid brokerage companies such as Fidelity, Charles Schwab and E-Trade.
